risk_note: RV2 ledger: bad debt writeoff. A new ledger worker module generates candidates once the accounting day's R3 daily check is done (processed_events ledger.daily_check_done for app, D-1): the scan is only a prefilter; each account is re-checked in its own transaction under the users row then balance row locks (deletion status, available, negative_since, ledger.bad_debt_days, ledger.bad_debt_min_fen from B2-12e), then a PENDING row is inserted through transitionBadDebtWriteoff GENERATE with the partial unique index as backstop. adminListBadDebtWriteoffs (fund.writeoff or fund.view) and adminApproveBadDebtWriteoff (fund.writeoff, sms step-up) leave planned: approval locks users, balances and the candidate row, re-reads available and frozen; frozen > 0 with ledger.bad_debt_require_no_frozen.enabled on → 20001 writeoff_frozen_pending and the row stays PENDING; available >= 0 → CANCELLED, 200, written_off_fen 0, no voucher; otherwise a BAD_DEBT_WRITEOFF voucher BADDEBT:{account_id}:{candidate_id} for -available through ledger.post, APPROVED, audit bad_debt_writeoff_approve. The linked-account risk mark is out of scope (D10-727 ③, B2-12g in identity). Integration spec/ledger/bad-debt-writeoffs 32/32 pass after rebase.

reviews.note: codex-run.sh review --review-type money: round 1 fail (S1 candidate generation used an unlocked stale snapshot: a balance that went positive and negative again between scan and insert still got a candidate with the old negative_since), round 2 pass (per-account re-check under users then balance locks; checklist rounding, sign, idempotency, concurrency, clock, app_id ok; partial_refund na).

spec_test_review.note: codex-run.sh review --review-type spec-test on tests by an independent Claude writer (claude-run.sh, approvals #36): round 1 fail (six S1: balance-row lock, Beijing midnight, version and balance_after, frozen-return interleaving, platform balance cache, amounts over 2^31), round 2 pass, round 3 pass on #14 expecting fields [amount_fen] (the platform names an additionalProperties error by the property; the contract does not say body).
